title: The Fedora 45 Sausage Factory
excerpt: This is a walkthrough of how Fedora turns source code and packages into the artifacts you download and install. It follows the a package from a packager’s git push to a composed release: ISOs, cloud images, container images, and OSTree deployments.
content_html:
This is a walkthrough of how Fedora turns source code and packages into the artifacts you download and install. It follows the a package from a packager’s git push to a composed release: ISOs, cloud images, container images, and OSTree deployments.

The walkthrough describes how the Fedora ‘sausage’ is created as of Fedora 45, things change all the time; I hope to have time to update this document every cycle or every few cycles of Fedora releases so there’s both history and people can find up to date information.

In fact this document is currently still living as Fedora 45 has not been released yet so this post likely will get updated until the release. There’s a few change proposals in flight that change some of the bits and bobs here. Specifically how the boot.iso is produced which is a decently large part of this post.

Thus now is also the right time to let me know if I got anything wrong, please e-mail me at cmdr@supakeen.com if you find any errors.

Starting Line: dist-git

Things starts with a packager pushing a commit to a package.

Fedora stores the source definitions of every package in individual Git repositories at src.fedoraproject.org. Each repo contains an RPM spec file, any downstream patches, and a sources file that points to upstream tarballs stored in a separate lookaside cache. The large binary files stay out of Git; the other files exist inside of Git and thus have full version control.

Packagers usually interact with these repos through fedpkg, a CLI that wraps the common operations: cloning repos, uploading source tarballs, submitting builds, and creating updates. The important thing about fedpkg build is what it actually does: it constructs a URL pointing at a specific commit in the Git repo and hands that to Koji, the build system. The build is fully reproducible from that commit hash.

Branches map to releases: rawhide for development, f44 for Fedora 44. The hosting is split between Pagure (src.fedoraproject.org) and Forgejo (forge.fedoraproject.org), with an ongoing migration from the former to the latter.

Packagers can do work without using fedpkg, but for the purposes of this post it’s easier to assume fedpkg is in use since it abstract away some of the bits that are irrelevant to the reader.

Building Packages: Koji

When fedpkg build submits that Git URL, Koji takes over. Koji is Fedora’s build system. It has been around since Fedora 7, and it builds essentially everything.

Koji follows a hub-and-spoke architecture. The hub is a passive XML-RPC server that sits in front of a PostgreSQL database. Builder daemons poll the hub for work, create a fresh Mock chroot environment for each build, run the build, and upload the results. Every build starts from a clean room. You can never get a different result because someone installed something on the builder last week.

The organizational model is built around tags. A tag is a named collection of builds. Build targets map an incoming build request to two tags: a build tag (which defines the buildroot, the packages available during the build) and a destination tag (where the finished build lands). Tags support multiple inheritance, so you can layer a Fedora 44 tag on top of a base tag without duplicating everything.

Koji doesn’t just build RPMs. Through its plugin system and content generators, it also orchestrates image builds: Kiwi images via the kiwiBuild task type, Image Builder artifacts via imageBuilderBuild, and OSTree composes via runroot tasks. We’ll get to those.

Gating Updates: Bodhi

A fresh RPM build sitting in Koji doesn’t automatically reach users. For branched releases (anything that isn’t Rawhide), it goes through Bodhi, Fedora’s update management system.

Bodhi gates the release of updates through a feedback and testing cycle. A packager submits an update containing one or more builds. That update goes through a sequence of states: pending, testing, stable. Users and automated tests provide karma (+1 / -1). When an update hits +3 karma or spends enough days in testing, it will be automatically pushed to stable. If an update hits +1 karma the maintainer can manually push to stable (+2 for critical path).

Behind the scenes, Bodhi manages all of this through Koji tags. When an update moves from testing to stable, Bodhi moves the build from the f44-updates-testing tag to the f44-updates tag. It then invokes Pungi to compose the update repository, the actual yum/dnf repo that users pull from when they run dnf upgrade.

Critical path packages, the ones your system needs to boot and function, get stricter requirements: 14 days in testing instead of 7, and more karma needed. Bodhi also integrates with Greenwave and ResultsDB for CI test gating, so automated test failures can block an update from reaching stable.

For Rawhide, these processes are configured differently. Non-critical path packages go stable immediately unless there’s a gating policy (either because the package is in the critical path or because the package itself has one) it still applies and an update can be held back until things pass.

Composing a Release: Pungi

Individual RPMs, even with Bodhi’s gating, are just packages. Turning them into something you can download and install, an ISO, a cloud image, a repository, is the job of Pungi.

Pungi is the compose orchestrator. It doesn’t do much of the heavy lifting itself. Instead, it coordinates the tools that do, ensuring everything is built from the same consistent set of packages.

The name is a reference to the pungi, a snake-charming instrument. It “charms” Anaconda, Fedora’s installer. The pun has survived since 2006.

A compose starts when pungi-koji runs, either triggered by cron for nightly Rawhide composes, or manually for milestone releases. It loads a configuration file (for Fedora, that’s fedora.conf in the pungi-fedora repository) and runs through a sequence of phases.

Freezing the Package Set

The first real work Pungi does is snapshot the set of packages from a Koji tag. This is the Pkgset phase, and it’s critical: every subsequent phase works from this frozen set. If someone submits a new build to Koji while the compose is running, it won’t sneak into the compose. The tag-based snapshot makes the entire compose auditable. You can always determine exactly which versions of which packages ended up in any given compose.

Deciding What Goes Where: comps and variants

With the packages frozen, Pungi needs to figure out which packages belong in which product. This is where two XML inputs come in.

comps (fedora-comps) defines package groups, collections of related packages like gnome-desktop, server-product, or core. Each package in a group has a type: mandatory, default, optional, or conditional. This is the same grouping system that powers dnf group install and Anaconda’s Software Selection screen.

variants XML (variants-fedora.xml in pungi-fedora) defines the products in a compose: Everything, Server, Workstation, KDE, Silverblue, and so on. Each variant lists which comps groups it includes and which architectures it supports. Most variants in modern Fedora are is_empty="true", meaning they produce only images (via Kiwi, Image Builder, or OSTree) using packages from the Everything variant’s repository. Only Everything and Server actually run the package gathering pipeline.

Building Boot Images

The Buildinstall phase runs lorax to create boot.iso, the image that boots the Anaconda installer. Lorax installs a minimal package set into a temporary root, configures the Anaconda environment, compresses it into install.img, and wraps it with a bootloader into an ISO. One lorax task runs per variant-architecture combination, typically in a Koji runroot environment for isolation.

The resulting boot.iso is the foundation for installer ISOs. It doesn’t contain the packages themselves. Those get layered on top in the next step to produce a dvd.iso.

Producing ISOs

The Createiso phase takes the boot.iso from Buildinstall, overlays packages and repository metadata on top of it using xorriso, and produces the final installer ISOs. For Fedora’s production compose, this means primarily the Server dvd.iso. Most other variants get their media from Kiwi or Image Builder instead.

Building Images with Kiwi

Kiwi is the primary image-building tool in Fedora’s compose. It builds cloud images (AWS, Azure, GCP, generic), Vagrant boxes, container base images, WSL images, and live ISOs for most desktop spins.

Kiwi was originally created at SUSE around 2005 and is a two-step builder: prepare a root filesystem by installing packages, then package it into the target format. Image definitions are XML files validated against a RELAX NG schema. Fedora’s definitions live in the fedora-kiwi-descriptions repository, organized under teams: teams/cloud/, teams/kde/, teams/spins/, teams/wsl/.

Kiwi integrates with Koji through a built-in plugin providing the kiwiBuild task type. The parent task checks out the image description from SCM, parses the XML, and spawns one subtask per architecture. Each subtask creates a Mock buildroot, replaces all repository definitions in the XML with Koji-controlled repos (so the build uses the compose’s frozen package set), runs kiwi-ng system build, and uploads the results.

Building Images with Image Builder

Image Builder handles the ostree-based and bootc-based artifacts: Atomic Desktop ISOs, Fedora IoT, Fedora Minimal, and boot.iso.

Under the hood, Image Builder is built on top of osbuild, a pipeline-based build engine that processes JSON manifests. Each manifest describes a directed acyclic graph of pipelines, and each pipeline runs sequential stages, small executables that do one thing (install packages, configure a bootloader, create a partition table, embed an OSTree commit). There are currently 176 stages. Stages run in bubblewrap-sandboxed environments with filesystem and network isolation.

The image-builder CLI is stateless: it reads distribution definitions, resolves package dependencies, generates an osbuild manifest, and runs osbuild directly.

Image Builder integrates with Koji through koji-image-builder, a separate Koji plugin providing the imageBuilderBuild task type. Each build runs image-builder inside a Mock buildroot on a Koji worker.

Building Atomic Desktops: rpm-ostree

Fedora Silverblue, Kinoite, Sway Atomic, Budgie Atomic, and COSMIC Atomic are all built differently from traditional package-based variants. Instead of shipping a pile of RPMs for the user to install, these variants ship a versioned, checksummed filesystem tree, an OSTree commit, that the client replicates atomically.

rpm-ostree is the tool that makes this work. It’s a hybrid image/package system, combining libostree (atomic OS tree deployment) with RPM (package management via libdnf).

On the compose side, rpm-ostree compose tree takes a treefile (a YAML specification listing packages, configuration, and post-processing scripts) and a set of RPM repositories, and produces an OSTree commit. Pungi’s OSTree phase invokes this command in a Koji runroot environment for each Atomic Desktop variant.

The treefiles live in the workstation-ostree-config repository. They use a layered include system: silverblue-ostree.yaml includes silverblue-common.yaml, which includes common.yaml, which conditionally includes fedora.yaml and architecture- specific files. The comps-sync.py script bridges the gap between comps groups and treefile package lists. It parses the comps XML, extracts the default and mandatory packages from groups like gnome-desktop and workstation-product, and writes them into generated YAML files. This way, the desktop environment packages stay in sync with what comps defines, while the treefile adds ostree-specific packages (bootupd, composefs) and applies exclusions for packages that are Flatpak’d or incompatible with ostree.

Compose Metadata: productmd

Every compose produces a set of metadata files that describe what’s in it. These are defined by productmd, a Python library that standardizes the format.

The key files are:

  • composeinfo.json, release identity, variant definitions, filesystem paths
  • images.json, every image with its type, format, checksums, and size
  • rpms.json, every RPM organized by variant and architecture
  • .treeinfo, per-variant metadata consumed by Anaconda to find installation trees

Pungi creates these as it goes. At the start, it generates a compose ID (e.g., Fedora-Rawhide-20260723.n.0). Each image-producing phase adds Image objects. The Gather phase populates the RPMs manifest. At finalization, everything gets written out.

Downstream consumers rely on these files heavily. Anaconda reads .treeinfo to discover where to find packages and boot images during installation. Bodhi inspects compose metadata for update management. openQA reads images.json to locate images for testing. Mirror management tools query the metadata to decide what to sync.

Testing: openQA

Once a compose finishes, openQA picks it up for automated testing. openQA is an automated test system for operating systems, originally developed by SUSE and adapted for Fedora by Adam Williamson and the Fedora QA team.

openQA boots the compose’s images in virtual machines and runs through test scenarios: installation workflows (interactive, kickstart, various disk layouts), desktop functionality, upgrade paths, and basic system validation. Tests are written as a combination of test scripts (“needles” for visual matching and Perl test modules for interaction) and are maintained in the os-autoinst-distri-fedora repository.

Every nightly Rawhide compose and every milestone compose (Beta, Final) triggers an openQA run. Results feed into the release validation process, and blocking bugs found by openQA can hold a release. The system also tests update composes from Bodhi, catching regressions before they reach users.

The Sausage

Here’s how the phases flow in a typical Fedora compose:

  pungi-koji
    │
    ├── Step 1: Init
    │     Parse comps + variants XML
    │
    ├── Step 2: Pkgset
    │     Snapshot packages from Koji tag
    │
    ├── Step 3: Essentials (parallel)
    │     ├── Buildinstall (lorax → boot.iso)
    │     ├── Gather + Createrepo (package repos)
    │     └── OSTree (rpm-ostree compose tree)
    │
    ├── Step 4: Images (parallel)
    │     ├── Createiso (dvd.iso from boot.iso + packages)
    │     ├── KiwiBuild (cloud, live, containers, WSL)
    │     └── ImageBuilder (Atomic Desktop ISOs, IoT, Minimal)
    │
    │   (OstreeContainer runs in background through steps 3-4)
    │
    ├── Step 5: Checksums
    │     Write productmd metadata, SHA256 checksums
    │
    └── Step 6: Test
          Run repoclosure, verify compose integrity

The barriers between steps matter. Step 3 must complete before step 4 starts, because Createiso needs boot.iso, the image phases need package repos, and ImageBuilder needs OSTree commits.

Governance: Changes Process

Major modifications to Fedora, whether new tools, default changes, or mass rebuilds, go through the Changes process. This is the governance mechanism that tracks proposals like “use Kiwi for cloud images” or “switch boot.iso to Image Builder.”

Changes come in two flavors. System-Wide changes affect critical path packages or system defaults and need detailed proposals, contingency plans, test plans, and FESCo approval. Self-Contained changes are scoped to packages the proposer owns and get lighter review.

The lifecycle is: draft a wiki page, submit it, get reviewed by the Change Wrangler, get voted on by FESCo (the 9-member elected engineering steering committee), implement in Rawhide, and meet completion checkpoints tied to the release schedule. Miss the Beta Freeze deadline and your change gets deferred to the next release automatically.

blocks.html_en: Starting Line: dist-git

sentences.en: Starting Line: dist-git
sentences.zh: 起始行：dist-git

blocks.html_en: Things starts with a packager pushing a commit to a package.

sentences.en: Things starts with a packager pushing a commit to a package.
sentences.zh: 事情从打包者将提交推送到包开始。

blocks.html_en: Fedora stores the source definitions of every package in individual Git repositories at src.fedoraproject.org. Each repo contains an RPM spec file, any downstream patches, and a sources file that points to upstream tarballs stored in a separate lookaside cache. The large binary files stay out of Git; the other files exist inside of Git and thus have full version control.

sentences.en: Fedora stores the source definitions of every package in individual Git repositories at src.fedoraproject.org.
sentences.zh: Fedora 将每个包的源定义存储在 src.fedoraproject.org 上的各个 Git 存储库中。

sentences.en: Each repo contains an RPM spec file, any downstream patches, and a sources file that points to upstream tarballs stored in a separate lookaside cache.
sentences.zh: 每个存储库都包含一个 RPM 规范文件、任何下游补丁以及一个指向存储在单独的后备缓存中的上游 tarball 的源文件。

sentences.en: The large binary files stay out of Git; the other files exist inside of Git and thus have full version control.
sentences.zh: 大型二进制文件远离 Git；其他文件存在于 Git 内部，因此具有完整的版本控制。

blocks.html_en: Packagers usually interact with these repos through fedpkg, a CLI that wraps the common operations: cloning repos, uploading source tarballs, submitting builds, and creating updates. The important thing about fedpkg build is what it actually does: it constructs a URL pointing at a specific commit in the Git repo and hands that to Koji, the build system. The build is fully reproducible from that commit hash.

sentences.en: Packagers usually interact with these repos through fedpkg, a CLI that wraps the common operations: cloning repos, uploading source tarballs, submitting builds, and creating updates.
sentences.zh: 打包者通常通过 fedpkg 与这些存储库进行交互，fedpkg 是一个包含常见操作的 CLI：克隆存储库、上传源 tarball、提交构建和创建更新。

sentences.en: The important thing about fedpkg build is what it actually does: it constructs a URL pointing at a specific commit in the Git repo and hands that to Koji, the build system.
sentences.zh: fedpkg build 的重要之处在于它实际上做了什么：它构建一个指向 Git 存储库中特定提交的 URL，并将其交给构建系统 Koji。

sentences.en: The build is fully reproducible from that commit hash.
sentences.zh: 构建可以从该提交哈希完全重现。

blocks.html_en: Branches map to releases: rawhide for development, f44 for Fedora 44. The hosting is split between Pagure (src.fedoraproject.org) and Forgejo (forge.fedoraproject.org), with an ongoing migration from the former to the latter.

sentences.en: Branches map to releases: rawhide for development, f44 for Fedora 44.
sentences.zh: 分支映射到版本：rawhide 用于开发，f44 用于 Fedora 44。

sentences.en: The hosting is split between Pagure (src.fedoraproject.org) and Forgejo (forge.fedoraproject.org), with an ongoing migration from the former to the latter.
sentences.zh: 托管分为 Pagure (src.fedoraproject.org) 和 Forgejo (forge.fedoraproject.org)，并且正在进行从前者到后者的迁移。

blocks.html_en: Packagers can do work without using fedpkg, but for the purposes of this post it’s easier to assume fedpkg is in use since it abstract away some of the bits that are irrelevant to the reader.

sentences.en: Packagers can do work without using fedpkg, but for the purposes of this post it’s easier to assume fedpkg is in use since it abstract away some of the bits that are irrelevant to the reader.
sentences.zh: 打包者可以在不使用 fedpkg 的情况下完成工作，但就本文而言，更容易假设 fedpkg 正在使用，因为它抽象了一些与读者无关的位。

blocks.html_en: Building Packages: Koji

sentences.en: Building Packages: Koji
sentences.zh: 构建包：Koji

blocks.html_en: When fedpkg build submits that Git URL, Koji takes over. Koji is Fedora’s build system. It has been around since Fedora 7, and it builds essentially everything.

sentences.en: When fedpkg build submits that Git URL, Koji takes over.
sentences.zh: 当 fedpkg build 提交该 Git URL 时，Koji 接管。

sentences.en: Koji is Fedora’s build system.
sentences.zh: Koji 是 Fedora 的构建系统。

sentences.en: It has been around since Fedora 7, and it builds essentially everything.
sentences.zh: 它自 Fedora 7 以来就已存在，并且几乎构建了所有内容。

blocks.html_en: Koji follows a hub-and-spoke architecture. The hub is a passive XML-RPC server that sits in front of a PostgreSQL database. Builder daemons poll the hub for work, create a fresh Mock chroot environment for each build, run the build, and upload the results. Every build starts from a clean room. You can never get a different result because someone installed something on the builder last week.

sentences.en: Koji follows a hub-and-spoke architecture.
sentences.zh: Koji 遵循中心辐射型架构。

sentences.en: The hub is a passive XML-RPC server that sits in front of a PostgreSQL database.
sentences.zh: 该集线器是一个被动的 XML-RPC 服务器，位于 PostgreSQL 数据库前面。

sentences.en: Builder daemons poll the hub for work, create a fresh Mock chroot environment for each build, run the build, and upload the results.
sentences.zh: 构建器守护进程轮询集线器进行工作，为每个构建创建一个新的模拟 chroot 环境，运行构建并上传结果。

sentences.en: Every build starts from a clean room.
sentences.zh: 每个构建都从洁净室开始。

sentences.en: You can never get a different result because someone installed something on the builder last week.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会因为上周有人在构建器上安装了某些东西而得到不同的结果。

blocks.html_en: The organizational model is built around tags. A tag is a named collection of builds. Build targets map an incoming build request to two tags: a build tag (which defines the buildroot, the packages available during the build) and a destination tag (where the finished build lands). Tags support multiple inheritance, so you can layer a Fedora 44 tag on top of a base tag without duplicating everything.

sentences.en: The organizational model is built around tags.
sentences.zh: 组织模型是围绕标签构建的。

sentences.en: A tag is a named collection of builds.
sentences.zh: 标签是构建的命名集合。

sentences.en: Build targets map an incoming build request to two tags: a build tag (which defines the buildroot, the packages available during the build) and a destination tag (where the finished build lands).
sentences.zh: 构建目标将传入的构建请求映射到两个标签：构建标签（定义构建根、构建期间可用的包）和目标标签（完成的构建所在的位置）。

sentences.en: Tags support multiple inheritance, so you can layer a Fedora 44 tag on top of a base tag without duplicating everything.
sentences.zh: 标签支持多重继承，因此您可以将 Fedora 44 标签分层在基本标签之上，而无需复制所有内容。

blocks.html_en: Koji doesn’t just build RPMs. Through its plugin system and content generators, it also orchestrates image builds: Kiwi images via the kiwiBuild task type, Image Builder artifacts via imageBuilderBuild, and OSTree composes via runroot tasks. We’ll get to those.

sentences.en: Koji doesn’t just build RPMs.
sentences.zh: Koji 不仅仅构建 RPM。

sentences.en: Through its plugin system and content generators, it also orchestrates image builds: Kiwi images via the kiwiBuild task type, Image Builder artifacts via imageBuilderBuild, and OSTree composes via runroot tasks.
sentences.zh: 通过其插件系统和内容生成器，它还可以编排图像构建：通过 kiwiBuild 任务类型构建 Kiwi 图像，通过 imageBuilderBuild 构建图像构建器工件，以及通过 runroot 任务构建 OSTree。

sentences.en: We’ll get to those.
sentences.zh: 我们会解决这些问题的。

blocks.html_en: Gating Updates: Bodhi

sentences.en: Gating Updates: Bodhi
sentences.zh: 门控更新：菩提

blocks.html_en: A fresh RPM build sitting in Koji doesn’t automatically reach users. For branched releases (anything that isn’t Rawhide), it goes through Bodhi, Fedora’s update management system.

sentences.en: A fresh RPM build sitting in Koji doesn’t automatically reach users.
sentences.zh: Koji 中的新 RPM 版本不会自动到达用户手中。

sentences.en: For branched releases (anything that isn’t Rawhide), it goes through Bodhi, Fedora’s update management system.
sentences.zh: 对于分支版本（任何不是 Rawhide 的版本），它会通过 Fedora 的更新管理系统 Bodhi。

blocks.html_en: Bodhi gates the release of updates through a feedback and testing cycle. A packager submits an update containing one or more builds. That update goes through a sequence of states: pending, testing, stable. Users and automated tests provide karma (+1 / -1). When an update hits +3 karma or spends enough days in testing, it will be automatically pushed to stable. If an update hits +1 karma the maintainer can manually push to stable (+2 for critical path).

sentences.en: Bodhi gates the release of updates through a feedback and testing cycle.
sentences.zh: Bodhi 通过反馈和测试周期来控制更新的发布。

sentences.en: A packager submits an update containing one or more builds.
sentences.zh: 打包者提交包含一个或多个构建的更新。

sentences.en: That update goes through a sequence of states: pending, testing, stable.
sentences.zh: 该更新会经历一系列状态：待定、测试、稳定。

sentences.en: Users and automated tests provide karma (+1 / -1).
sentences.zh: 用户和自动化测试提供业力 (+1 / -1)。

sentences.en: When an update hits +3 karma or spends enough days in testing, it will be automatically pushed to stable.
sentences.zh: 当更新达到 +3 karma 或花费足够多的时间进行测试时，它将自动推送到稳定版本。

sentences.en: If an update hits +1 karma the maintainer can manually push to stable (+2 for critical path).
sentences.zh: 如果更新达到+1 karma，维护者可以手动推送到稳定版本（关键路径为+2）。

blocks.html_en: Behind the scenes, Bodhi manages all of this through Koji tags. When an update moves from testing to stable, Bodhi moves the build from the f44-updates-testing tag to the f44-updates tag. It then invokes Pungi to compose the update repository, the actual yum/dnf repo that users pull from when they run dnf upgrade.

sentences.en: Behind the scenes, Bodhi manages all of this through Koji tags.
sentences.zh: 在幕后，Bodhi 通过 Koji 标签管理所有这一切。

sentences.en: When an update moves from testing to stable, Bodhi moves the build from the f44-updates-testing tag to the f44-updates tag.
sentences.zh: 当更新从测试转向稳定时，Bodhi 将构建从 f44-updates-testing 标签移动到 f44-updates 标签。

sentences.en: It then invokes Pungi to compose the update repository, the actual yum/dnf repo that users pull from when they run dnf upgrade.
sentences.zh: 然后，它调用 Pungi 来构建更新存储库，即用户运行 dnf 升级时从中提取的实际 yum/dnf 存储库。

blocks.html_en: Critical path packages, the ones your system needs to boot and function, get stricter requirements: 14 days in testing instead of 7, and more karma needed. Bodhi also integrates with Greenwave and ResultsDB for CI test gating, so automated test failures can block an update from reaching stable.

sentences.en: Critical path packages, the ones your system needs to boot and function, get stricter requirements: 14 days in testing instead of 7, and more karma needed.
sentences.zh: 关键路径包（系统启动和运行所需的包）受到更严格的要求：测试需要 14 天而不是 7 天，并且需要更多的业力。

sentences.en: Bodhi also integrates with Greenwave and ResultsDB for CI test gating, so automated test failures can block an update from reaching stable.
sentences.zh: Bodhi 还与 Greenwave 和 ResultsDB 集成以进行 CI 测试门控，因此自动化测试失败可能会阻止更新达到稳定状态。

blocks.html_en: For Rawhide, these processes are configured differently. Non-critical path packages go stable immediately unless there’s a gating policy (either because the package is in the critical path or because the package itself has one) it still applies and an update can be held back until things pass.

sentences.en: For Rawhide, these processes are configured differently.
sentences.zh: 对于 Rawhide，这些进程的配置不同。

sentences.en: Non-critical path packages go stable immediately unless there’s a gating policy (either because the package is in the critical path or because the package itself has one) it still applies and an update can be held back until things pass.
sentences.zh: 非关键路径包会立即变得稳定，除非存在门控策略（因为包位于关键路径中，或者因为包本身有一个），否则它仍然适用，并且可以推迟更新，直到事情通过。

blocks.html_en: Composing a Release: Pungi

sentences.en: Composing a Release: Pungi
sentences.zh: 撰写发行版：Pungi

blocks.html_en: Individual RPMs, even with Bodhi’s gating, are just packages. Turning them into something you can download and install, an ISO, a cloud image, a repository, is the job of Pungi.

sentences.en: Individual RPMs, even with Bodhi’s gating, are just packages.
sentences.zh: 单独的 RPM，即使有 Bodhi 的门控，也只是包。

sentences.en: Turning them into something you can download and install, an ISO, a cloud image, a repository, is the job of Pungi.
sentences.zh: 将它们变成可以下载和安装的东西、ISO、云映像、存储库，就是 Pungi 的工作。

blocks.html_en: Pungi is the compose orchestrator. It doesn’t do much of the heavy lifting itself. Instead, it coordinates the tools that do, ensuring everything is built from the same consistent set of packages.

sentences.en: Pungi is the compose orchestrator.
sentences.zh: Pungi 是作曲编曲家。

sentences.en: It doesn’t do much of the heavy lifting itself.
sentences.zh: 它本身并没有做太多繁重的工作。

sentences.en: Instead, it coordinates the tools that do, ensuring everything is built from the same consistent set of packages.
sentences.zh: 相反，它协调执行此操作的工具，确保所有内容都是从同一组一致的包构建的。

blocks.html_en: The name is a reference to the pungi, a snake-charming instrument. It “charms” Anaconda, Fedora’s installer. The pun has survived since 2006.

sentences.en: The name is a reference to the pungi, a snake-charming instrument.
sentences.zh: 这个名字来源于“pungi”，一种迷蛇乐器。

sentences.en: It “charms” Anaconda, Fedora’s installer.
sentences.zh: 它“迷住”了 Fedora 的安装程序 Anaconda。

sentences.en: The pun has survived since 2006.
sentences.zh: 这个双关语自 2006 年以来一直存在。

blocks.html_en: A compose starts when pungi-koji runs, either triggered by cron for nightly Rawhide composes, or manually for milestone releases. It loads a configuration file (for Fedora, that’s fedora.conf in the pungi-fedora repository) and runs through a sequence of phases.

sentences.en: A compose starts when pungi-koji runs, either triggered by cron for nightly Rawhide composes, or manually for milestone releases.
sentences.zh: 当 pungi-koji 运行时，撰写开始，由 cron 触发以进行夜间 Rawhide 撰写，或手动触发以进行里程碑发布。

sentences.en: It loads a configuration file (for Fedora, that’s fedora.conf in the pungi-fedora repository) and runs through a sequence of phases.
sentences.zh: 它加载一个配置文件（对于 Fedora，这是 pungi-fedora 存储库中的 fedora.conf）并运行一系列阶段。

blocks.html_en: Freezing the Package Set

sentences.en: Freezing the Package Set
sentences.zh: 冻结包集

blocks.html_en: The first real work Pungi does is snapshot the set of packages from a Koji tag. This is the Pkgset phase, and it’s critical: every subsequent phase works from this frozen set. If someone submits a new build to Koji while the compose is running, it won’t sneak into the compose. The tag-based snapshot makes the entire compose auditable. You can always determine exactly which versions of which packages ended up in any given compose.

sentences.en: The first real work Pungi does is snapshot the set of packages from a Koji tag.
sentences.zh: Pungi 所做的第一个实际工作是从 Koji 标签中快照一组包。

sentences.en: This is the Pkgset phase, and it’s critical: every subsequent phase works from this frozen set.
sentences.zh: 这是 Pkgset 阶段，这一点至关重要：每个后续阶段都从这个冻结集开始工作。

sentences.en: If someone submits a new build to Koji while the compose is running, it won’t sneak into the compose.
sentences.zh: 如果有人在 compose 运行时向 Koji 提交新的构建，它不会潜入到 compose 中。

sentences.en: The tag-based snapshot makes the entire compose auditable.
sentences.zh: 基于标签的快照使整个组合可审计。

sentences.en: You can always determine exactly which versions of which packages ended up in any given compose.
sentences.zh: 您始终可以准确确定哪些包的哪些版本最终出现在任何给定的组合中。

blocks.html_en: Deciding What Goes Where: comps and variants

sentences.en: Deciding What Goes Where: comps and variants
sentences.zh: 决定什么去哪里：组合和变体

blocks.html_en: With the packages frozen, Pungi needs to figure out which packages belong in which product. This is where two XML inputs come in.

sentences.en: With the packages frozen, Pungi needs to figure out which packages belong in which product.
sentences.zh: 包裹被冻结后，Pungi 需要弄清楚哪些包裹属于哪个产品。

sentences.en: This is where two XML inputs come in.
sentences.zh: 这就是两个 XML 输入的用武之地。

blocks.html_en: comps (fedora-comps) defines package groups, collections of related packages like gnome-desktop, server-product, or core. Each package in a group has a type: mandatory, default, optional, or conditional. This is the same grouping system that powers dnf group install and Anaconda’s Software Selection screen.

sentences.en: comps (fedora-comps) defines package groups, collections of related packages like gnome-desktop, server-product, or core.
sentences.zh: comps (fedora-comps) 定义包组、相关包的集合，例如 gnome-desktop、服务器产品或 core。

sentences.en: Each package in a group has a type: mandatory, default, optional, or conditional.
sentences.zh: 组中的每个包都有一个类型：强制、默认、可选或条件。

sentences.en: This is the same grouping system that powers dnf group install and Anaconda’s Software Selection screen.
sentences.zh: 这与支持 dnf 组安装和 Anaconda 的软件选择屏幕的分组系统相同。

blocks.html_en: variants XML (variants-fedora.xml in pungi-fedora) defines the products in a compose: Everything, Server, Workstation, KDE, Silverblue, and so on. Each variant lists which comps groups it includes and which architectures it supports. Most variants in modern Fedora are is_empty="true", meaning they produce only images (via Kiwi, Image Builder, or OSTree) using packages from the Everything variant’s repository. Only Everything and Server actually run the package gathering pipeline.

sentences.en: variants XML (variants-fedora.xml in pungi-fedora) defines the products in a compose: Everything, Server, Workstation, KDE, Silverblue, and so on.
sentences.zh: 变体 XML（pungi-fedora 中的variants-fedora.xml）定义组合中的产品：Everything、Server、Workstation、KDE、Silverblue 等。

sentences.en: Each variant lists which comps groups it includes and which architectures it supports.
sentences.zh: 每个变体都列出了它包含哪些组合组以及它支持哪些架构。

sentences.en: Most variants in modern Fedora are is_empty="true", meaning they produce only images (via Kiwi, Image Builder, or OSTree) using packages from the Everything variant’s repository.
sentences.zh: 现代 Fedora 中的大多数变体都是 is_empty="true"，这意味着它们仅使用 Everything 变体存储库中的包生成图像（通过 Kiwi、Image Builder 或 OSTree）。

sentences.en: Only Everything and Server actually run the package gathering pipeline.
sentences.zh: 只有 Everything 和 Server 实际上运行包收集管道。

blocks.html_en: Building Boot Images

sentences.en: Building Boot Images
sentences.zh: 构建启动映像

blocks.html_en: The Buildinstall phase runs lorax to create boot.iso, the image that boots the Anaconda installer. Lorax installs a minimal package set into a temporary root, configures the Anaconda environment, compresses it into install.img, and wraps it with a bootloader into an ISO. One lorax task runs per variant-architecture combination, typically in a Koji runroot environment for isolation.

sentences.en: The Buildinstall phase runs lorax to create boot.iso, the image that boots the Anaconda installer.
sentences.zh: Buildinstall 阶段运行 lorax 以创建 boot.iso，即启动 Anaconda 安装程序的映像。

sentences.en: Lorax installs a minimal package set into a temporary root, configures the Anaconda environment, compresses it into install.img, and wraps it with a bootloader into an ISO.
sentences.zh: Lorax 将最小软件包集安装到临时根目录中，配置 Anaconda 环境，将其压缩到 install.img 中，并使用引导加载程序将其包装到 ISO 中。

sentences.en: One lorax task runs per variant-architecture combination, typically in a Koji runroot environment for isolation.
sentences.zh: 每个变体架构组合运行一个 lorax 任务，通常在 Koji runroot 环境中进行隔离。

blocks.html_en: The resulting boot.iso is the foundation for installer ISOs. It doesn’t contain the packages themselves. Those get layered on top in the next step to produce a dvd.iso.

sentences.en: The resulting boot.iso is the foundation for installer ISOs.
sentences.zh: 生成的 boot.iso 是安装程序 ISO 的基础。

sentences.en: It doesn’t contain the packages themselves.
sentences.zh: 它不包含包本身。

sentences.en: Those get layered on top in the next step to produce a dvd.iso.
sentences.zh: 这些将在下一步中分层放置在顶部以生成 dvd.iso。

blocks.html_en: Producing ISOs

sentences.en: Producing ISOs
sentences.zh: 制作 ISO

blocks.html_en: The Createiso phase takes the boot.iso from Buildinstall, overlays packages and repository metadata on top of it using xorriso, and produces the final installer ISOs. For Fedora’s production compose, this means primarily the Server dvd.iso. Most other variants get their media from Kiwi or Image Builder instead.

sentences.en: The Createiso phase takes the boot.iso from Buildinstall, overlays packages and repository metadata on top of it using xorriso, and produces the final installer ISOs.
sentences.zh: Createiso 阶段从 Buildinstall 获取 boot.iso，使用 xorriso 在其上覆盖软件包和存储库元数据，并生成最终的安装程序 ISO。

sentences.en: For Fedora’s production compose, this means primarily the Server dvd.iso.
sentences.zh: 对于 Fedora 的生产版本，这主要意味着服务器 dvd.iso。

sentences.en: Most other variants get their media from Kiwi or Image Builder instead.
sentences.zh: 大多数其他变体从 Kiwi 或 Image Builder 获取媒体。

blocks.html_en: Building Images with Kiwi

sentences.en: Building Images with Kiwi
sentences.zh: 用 Kiwi 构建图像

blocks.html_en: Kiwi is the primary image-building tool in Fedora’s compose. It builds cloud images (AWS, Azure, GCP, generic), Vagrant boxes, container base images, WSL images, and live ISOs for most desktop spins.

sentences.en: Kiwi is the primary image-building tool in Fedora’s compose.
sentences.zh: Kiwi 是 Fedora 中主要的镜像构建工具。

sentences.en: It builds cloud images (AWS, Azure, GCP, generic), Vagrant boxes, container base images, WSL images, and live ISOs for most desktop spins.
sentences.zh: 它为大多数桌面旋转构建云映像（AWS、Azure、GCP、通用）、Vagrant box、容器基础映像、WSL 映像和实时 ISO。

blocks.html_en: Kiwi was originally created at SUSE around 2005 and is a two-step builder: prepare a root filesystem by installing packages, then package it into the target format. Image definitions are XML files validated against a RELAX NG schema. Fedora’s definitions live in the fedora-kiwi-descriptions repository, organized under teams: teams/cloud/, teams/kde/, teams/spins/, teams/wsl/.

sentences.en: Kiwi was originally created at SUSE around 2005 and is a two-step builder: prepare a root filesystem by installing packages, then package it into the target format.
sentences.zh: Kiwi 最初于 2005 年左右在 SUSE 创建，是一个两步构建器：通过安装软件包来准备根文件系统，然后将其打包为目标格式。

sentences.en: Image definitions are XML files validated against a RELAX NG schema.
sentences.zh: 图像定义是根据 RELAX NG 模式验证的 XML 文件。

sentences.en: Fedora’s definitions live in the fedora-kiwi-descriptions repository, organized under teams: teams/cloud/, teams/kde/, teams/spins/, teams/wsl/.
sentences.zh: Fedora 的定义位于 fedora-kiwi-descriptions 存储库中，按团队组织：teams/cloud/、teams/kde/、teams/spins/、teams/wsl/。

blocks.html_en: Kiwi integrates with Koji through a built-in plugin providing the kiwiBuild task type. The parent task checks out the image description from SCM, parses the XML, and spawns one subtask per architecture. Each subtask creates a Mock buildroot, replaces all repository definitions in the XML with Koji-controlled repos (so the build uses the compose’s frozen package set), runs kiwi-ng system build, and uploads the results.

sentences.en: Kiwi integrates with Koji through a built-in plugin providing the kiwiBuild task type.
sentences.zh: Kiwi 通过提供 kiwiBuild 任务类型的内置插件与 Koji 集成。

sentences.en: The parent task checks out the image description from SCM, parses the XML, and spawns one subtask per architecture.
sentences.zh: 父任务从 SCM 检查图像描述，解析 XML，并为每个架构生成一个子任务。

sentences.en: Each subtask creates a Mock buildroot, replaces all repository definitions in the XML with Koji-controlled repos (so the build uses the compose’s frozen package set), runs kiwi-ng system build, and uploads the results.
sentences.zh: 每个子任务都会创建一个 Mock buildroot，用 Koji 控制的存储库替换 XML 中的所有存储库定义（因此构建使用 compose 的冻结包集），运行 kiwi-ng 系统构建，并上传结果。

blocks.html_en: Building Images with Image Builder

sentences.en: Building Images with Image Builder
sentences.zh: 使用图像生成器构建图像

blocks.html_en: Image Builder handles the ostree-based and bootc-based artifacts: Atomic Desktop ISOs, Fedora IoT, Fedora Minimal, and boot.iso.

sentences.en: Image Builder handles the ostree-based and bootc-based artifacts: Atomic Desktop ISOs, Fedora IoT, Fedora Minimal, and boot.iso.
sentences.zh: Image Builder 处理基于 ostree 和基于 bootc 的工件：Atomic Desktop ISO、Fedora IoT、Fedora Minimal 和 boot.iso。

blocks.html_en: Under the hood, Image Builder is built on top of osbuild, a pipeline-based build engine that processes JSON manifests. Each manifest describes a directed acyclic graph of pipelines, and each pipeline runs sequential stages, small executables that do one thing (install packages, configure a bootloader, create a partition table, embed an OSTree commit). There are currently 176 stages. Stages run in bubblewrap-sandboxed environments with filesystem and network isolation.

sentences.en: Under the hood, Image Builder is built on top of osbuild, a pipeline-based build engine that processes JSON manifests.
sentences.zh: 在底层，Image Builder 构建在 osbuild 之上，osbuild 是一个基于管道的构建引擎，用于处理 JSON 清单。

sentences.en: Each manifest describes a directed acyclic graph of pipelines, and each pipeline runs sequential stages, small executables that do one thing (install packages, configure a bootloader, create a partition table, embed an OSTree commit).
sentences.zh: 每个清单都描述了管道的有向无环图，每个管道运行连续的阶段，即执行一件事的小型可执行文件（安装包、配置引导加载程序、创建分区表、嵌入 OSTree 提交）。

sentences.en: There are currently 176 stages.
sentences.zh: 目前有176个阶段。

sentences.en: Stages run in bubblewrap-sandboxed environments with filesystem and network isolation.
sentences.zh: 阶段在具有文件系统和网络隔离的 bubblewrap 沙盒环境中运行。

blocks.html_en: The image-builder CLI is stateless: it reads distribution definitions, resolves package dependencies, generates an osbuild manifest, and runs osbuild directly.

sentences.en: The image-builder CLI is stateless: it reads distribution definitions, resolves package dependencies, generates an osbuild manifest, and runs osbuild directly.
sentences.zh: 镜像构建器 CLI 是无状态的：它读取发行版定义、解析包依赖性、生成 osbuild 清单并直接运行 osbuild。

blocks.html_en: Image Builder integrates with Koji through koji-image-builder, a separate Koji plugin providing the imageBuilderBuild task type. Each build runs image-builder inside a Mock buildroot on a Koji worker.

sentences.en: Image Builder integrates with Koji through koji-image-builder, a separate Koji plugin providing the imageBuilderBuild task type.
sentences.zh: Image Builder 通过 koji-image-builder 与 Koji 集成，koji-image-builder 是一个提供 imageBuilderBuild 任务类型的单独 Koji 插件。

sentences.en: Each build runs image-builder inside a Mock buildroot on a Koji worker.
sentences.zh: 每个构建都在 Koji 工作线程上的 Mock buildroot 中运行 image-builder。

blocks.html_en: Building Atomic Desktops: rpm-ostree

sentences.en: Building Atomic Desktops: rpm-ostree
sentences.zh: 构建原子桌面：rpm-ostree

blocks.html_en: Fedora Silverblue, Kinoite, Sway Atomic, Budgie Atomic, and COSMIC Atomic are all built differently from traditional package-based variants. Instead of shipping a pile of RPMs for the user to install, these variants ship a versioned, checksummed filesystem tree, an OSTree commit, that the client replicates atomically.

sentences.en: Fedora Silverblue, Kinoite, Sway Atomic, Budgie Atomic, and COSMIC Atomic are all built differently from traditional package-based variants.
sentences.zh: Fedora Silverblue、Kinoite、Sway Atomic、Budgie Atomic 和 COSMIC Atomic 的构建方式都与传统的基于包的变体不同。

sentences.en: Instead of shipping a pile of RPMs for the user to install, these variants ship a versioned, checksummed filesystem tree, an OSTree commit, that the client replicates atomically.
sentences.zh: 这些变体不是运送一堆 RPM 供用户安装，而是运送版本化、校验和的文件系统树（OSTree 提交），客户端以原子方式复制。

blocks.html_en: rpm-ostree is the tool that makes this work. It’s a hybrid image/package system, combining libostree (atomic OS tree deployment) with RPM (package management via libdnf).

sentences.en: rpm-ostree is the tool that makes this work.
sentences.zh: rpm-ostree 是实现此功能的工具。

sentences.en: It’s a hybrid image/package system, combining libostree (atomic OS tree deployment) with RPM (package management via libdnf).
sentences.zh: 它是一个混合映像/包系统，将 libostree（原子操作系统树部署）与 RPM（通过 libdnf 进行包管理）相结合。

blocks.html_en: On the compose side, rpm-ostree compose tree takes a treefile (a YAML specification listing packages, configuration, and post-processing scripts) and a set of RPM repositories, and produces an OSTree commit. Pungi’s OSTree phase invokes this command in a Koji runroot environment for each Atomic Desktop variant.

sentences.en: On the compose side, rpm-ostree compose tree takes a treefile (a YAML specification listing packages, configuration, and post-processing scripts) and a set of RPM repositories, and produces an OSTree commit.
sentences.zh: 在撰写方面，rpm-ostree 撰写树采用树文件（列出包、配置和后处理脚本的 YAML 规范）和一组 RPM 存储库，并生成 OSTree 提交。

sentences.en: Pungi’s OSTree phase invokes this command in a Koji runroot environment for each Atomic Desktop variant.
sentences.zh: Pungi 的 OSTree 阶段在 Koji runroot 环境中为每个 Atomic Desktop 变体调用此命令。

blocks.html_en: The treefiles live in the workstation-ostree-config repository. They use a layered include system: silverblue-ostree.yaml includes silverblue-common.yaml, which includes common.yaml, which conditionally includes fedora.yaml and architecture- specific files. The comps-sync.py script bridges the gap between comps groups and treefile package lists. It parses the comps XML, extracts the default and mandatory packages from groups like gnome-desktop and workstation-product, and writes them into generated YAML files. This way, the desktop environment packages stay in sync with what comps defines, while the treefile adds ostree-specific packages (bootupd, composefs) and applies exclusions for packages that are Flatpak’d or incompatible with ostree.

sentences.en: The treefiles live in the workstation-ostree-config repository.
sentences.zh: 树文件位于workstation-ostree-config 存储库中。

sentences.en: They use a layered include system: silverblue-ostree.yaml includes silverblue-common.yaml, which includes common.yaml, which conditionally includes fedora.yaml and architecture- specific files.
sentences.zh: 他们使用分层包含系统：silverblue-ostree.yaml 包含 silverblue-common.yaml，后者包含 common.yaml，后者有条件包含 fedora.yaml 和特定于架构的文件。

sentences.en: The comps-sync.py script bridges the gap between comps groups and treefile package lists.
sentences.zh: comps-sync.py 脚本弥补了 comps 组和树文件包列表之间的差距。

sentences.en: It parses the comps XML, extracts the default and mandatory packages from groups like gnome-desktop and workstation-product, and writes them into generated YAML files.
sentences.zh: 它解析 comps XML，从 gnome-desktop 和工作站产品等组中提取默认和强制包，并将它们写入生成的 YAML 文件中。

sentences.en: This way, the desktop environment packages stay in sync with what comps defines, while the treefile adds ostree-specific packages (bootupd, composefs) and applies exclusions for packages that are Flatpak’d or incompatible with ostree.
sentences.zh: 这样，桌面环境包与 comps 定义的包保持同步，而 treefile 添加 ostree 特定的包（bootupd、composefs），并对 Flatpak 或与 ostree 不兼容的包应用排除项。

blocks.html_en: Once a compose finishes, openQA picks it up for automated testing. openQA is an automated test system for operating systems, originally developed by SUSE and adapted for Fedora by Adam Williamson and the Fedora QA team.

sentences.zh: openQA 是一个操作系统的自动化测试系统，最初由 SUSE 开发，并由 Adam Williamson 和 Fedora QA 团队针对 Fedora 进行了改编。

content_html_zh:
这是 Fedora 如何将源代码和包转换为您下载和安装的工件的演练。 它遵循从打包者的 git 推送到组合发布的包：ISO、云映像、容器映像和 OSTree 部署。

演练描述了 Fedora “香肠”是如何从 Fedora 45 开始创建的，事情一直在变化；我希望有时间在 Fedora 版本的每个周期或每隔几个周期更新此文档，这样既有历史记录，人们也可以找到最新信息。

事实上，由于 Fedora 45 尚未发布，该文档目前仍然有效，因此这篇文章可能会在发布之前进行更新。 有一些正在实施的变更提案会改变这里的一些细节。 具体来说 boot.iso 是如何生成的，这是这篇文章的相当大的一部分。

因此，现在也是让我知道是否有任何错误的最佳时机，如果您发现任何错误，请发送电子邮件至 cmdr@supakeen.com。

起始行：dist-git

事情从打包者将提交推送到包开始。

Fedora 将每个包的源定义存储在 src.fedoraproject.org 上的各个 Git 存储库中。 每个存储库都包含一个 RPM 规范文件、任何下游补丁以及一个指向存储在单独的后备缓存中的上游 tarball 的源文件。 大型二进制文件远离 Git；其他文件存在于 Git 内部，因此具有完整的版本控制。

打包者通常通过 fedpkg 与这些存储库进行交互，fedpkg 是一个包含常见操作的 CLI：克隆存储库、上传源 tarball、提交构建和创建更新。 fedpkg build 的重要之处在于它实际上做了什么：它构建一个指向 Git 存储库中特定提交的 URL，并将其交给构建系统 Koji。 构建可以从该提交哈希完全重现。

分支映射到版本：rawhide 用于开发，f44 用于 Fedora 44。 托管分为 Pagure (src.fedoraproject.org) 和 Forgejo (forge.fedoraproject.org)，并且正在进行从前者到后者的迁移。

打包者可以在不使用 fedpkg 的情况下完成工作，但就本文而言，更容易假设 fedpkg 正在使用，因为它抽象了一些与读者无关的位。

构建包：Koji

当 fedpkg build 提交该 Git URL 时，Koji 接管。 Koji 是 Fedora 的构建系统。 它自 Fedora 7 以来就已存在，并且几乎构建了所有内容。

Koji 遵循中心辐射型架构。 该集线器是一个被动的 XML-RPC 服务器，位于 PostgreSQL 数据库前面。 构建器守护进程轮询集线器进行工作，为每个构建创建一个新的模拟 chroot 环境，运行构建并上传结果。 每个构建都从洁净室开始。 你永远不会因为上周有人在构建器上安装了某些东西而得到不同的结果。

组织模型是围绕标签构建的。 标签是构建的命名集合。 构建目标将传入的构建请求映射到两个标签：构建标签（定义构建根、构建期间可用的包）和目标标签（完成的构建所在的位置）。 标签支持多重继承，因此您可以将 Fedora 44 标签分层在基本标签之上，而无需复制所有内容。

Koji 不仅仅构建 RPM。 通过其插件系统和内容生成器，它还可以编排图像构建：通过 kiwiBuild 任务类型构建 Kiwi 图像，通过 imageBuilderBuild 构建图像构建器工件，以及通过 runroot 任务构建 OSTree。 我们会解决这些问题的。

门控更新：菩提

Koji 中的新 RPM 版本不会自动到达用户手中。 对于分支版本（任何不是 Rawhide 的版本），它会通过 Fedora 的更新管理系统 Bodhi。

Bodhi 通过反馈和测试周期来控制更新的发布。 打包者提交包含一个或多个构建的更新。 该更新会经历一系列状态：待定、测试、稳定。 用户和自动化测试提供业力 (+1 / -1)。 当更新达到 +3 karma 或花费足够多的时间进行测试时，它将自动推送到稳定版本。 如果更新达到+1 karma，维护者可以手动推送到稳定版本（关键路径为+2）。

在幕后，Bodhi 通过 Koji 标签管理所有这一切。 当更新从测试转向稳定时，Bodhi 将构建从 f44-updates-testing 标签移动到 f44-updates 标签。 然后，它调用 Pungi 来构建更新存储库，即用户运行 dnf 升级时从中提取的实际 yum/dnf 存储库。

关键路径包（系统启动和运行所需的包）受到更严格的要求：测试需要 14 天而不是 7 天，并且需要更多的业力。 Bodhi 还与 Greenwave 和 ResultsDB 集成以进行 CI 测试门控，因此自动化测试失败可能会阻止更新达到稳定状态。

对于 Rawhide，这些进程的配置不同。 非关键路径包会立即变得稳定，除非存在门控策略（因为包位于关键路径中，或者因为包本身有一个），否则它仍然适用，并且可以推迟更新，直到事情通过。

撰写发行版：Pungi

单独的 RPM，即使有 Bodhi 的门控，也只是包。 将它们变成可以下载和安装的东西、ISO、云映像、存储库，就是 Pungi 的工作。

Pungi 是作曲编曲家。 它本身并没有做太多繁重的工作。 相反，它协调执行此操作的工具，确保所有内容都是从同一组一致的包构建的。

这个名字来源于“pungi”，一种迷蛇乐器。 它“迷住”了 Fedora 的安装程序 Anaconda。 这个双关语自 2006 年以来一直存在。

当 pungi-koji 运行时，撰写开始，由 cron 触发以进行夜间 Rawhide 撰写，或手动触发以进行里程碑发布。 它加载一个配置文件（对于 Fedora，这是 pungi-fedora 存储库中的 fedora.conf）并运行一系列阶段。

冻结包集

Pungi 所做的第一个实际工作是从 Koji 标签中快照一组包。 这是 Pkgset 阶段，这一点至关重要：每个后续阶段都从这个冻结集开始工作。 如果有人在 compose 运行时向 Koji 提交新的构建，它不会潜入到 compose 中。 基于标签的快照使整个组合可审计。 您始终可以准确确定哪些包的哪些版本最终出现在任何给定的组合中。

决定什么去哪里：组合和变体

包裹被冻结后，Pungi 需要弄清楚哪些包裹属于哪个产品。 这就是两个 XML 输入的用武之地。

comps (fedora-comps) 定义包组、相关包的集合，例如 gnome-desktop、服务器产品或 core。 组中的每个包都有一个类型：强制、默认、可选或条件。 这与支持 dnf 组安装和 Anaconda 的软件选择屏幕的分组系统相同。

变体 XML（pungi-fedora 中的variants-fedora.xml）定义组合中的产品：Everything、Server、Workstation、KDE、Silverblue 等。 每个变体都列出了它包含哪些组合组以及它支持哪些架构。 现代 Fedora 中的大多数变体都是 is_empty="true"，这意味着它们仅使用 Everything 变体存储库中的包生成图像（通过 Kiwi、Image Builder 或 OSTree）。 只有 Everything 和 Server 实际上运行包收集管道。

构建启动映像

Buildinstall 阶段运行 lorax 以创建 boot.iso，即启动 Anaconda 安装程序的映像。 Lorax 将最小软件包集安装到临时根目录中，配置 Anaconda 环境，将其压缩到 install.img 中，并使用引导加载程序将其包装到 ISO 中。 每个变体架构组合运行一个 lorax 任务，通常在 Koji runroot 环境中进行隔离。

生成的 boot.iso 是安装程序 ISO 的基础。 它不包含包本身。 这些将在下一步中分层放置在顶部以生成 dvd.iso。

制作 ISO

Createiso 阶段从 Buildinstall 获取 boot.iso，使用 xorriso 在其上覆盖软件包和存储库元数据，并生成最终的安装程序 ISO。 对于 Fedora 的生产版本，这主要意味着服务器 dvd.iso。 大多数其他变体从 Kiwi 或 Image Builder 获取媒体。

用 Kiwi 构建图像

Kiwi 是 Fedora 中主要的镜像构建工具。 它为大多数桌面旋转构建云映像（AWS、Azure、GCP、通用）、Vagrant box、容器基础映像、WSL 映像和实时 ISO。

Kiwi 最初于 2005 年左右在 SUSE 创建，是一个两步构建器：通过安装软件包来准备根文件系统，然后将其打包为目标格式。 图像定义是根据 RELAX NG 模式验证的 XML 文件。 Fedora 的定义位于 fedora-kiwi-descriptions 存储库中，按团队组织：teams/cloud/、teams/kde/、teams/spins/、teams/wsl/。

Kiwi 通过提供 kiwiBuild 任务类型的内置插件与 Koji 集成。 父任务从 SCM 检查图像描述，解析 XML，并为每个架构生成一个子任务。 每个子任务都会创建一个 Mock buildroot，用 Koji 控制的存储库替换 XML 中的所有存储库定义（因此构建使用 compose 的冻结包集），运行 kiwi-ng 系统构建，并上传结果。

使用图像生成器构建图像

Image Builder 处理基于 ostree 和基于 bootc 的工件：Atomic Desktop ISO、Fedora IoT、Fedora Minimal 和 boot.iso。

在底层，Image Builder 构建在 osbuild 之上，osbuild 是一个基于管道的构建引擎，用于处理 JSON 清单。 每个清单都描述了管道的有向无环图，每个管道运行连续的阶段，即执行一件事的小型可执行文件（安装包、配置引导加载程序、创建分区表、嵌入 OSTree 提交）。 目前有176个阶段。 阶段在具有文件系统和网络隔离的 bubblewrap 沙盒环境中运行。

镜像构建器 CLI 是无状态的：它读取发行版定义、解析包依赖性、生成 osbuild 清单并直接运行 osbuild。

Image Builder 通过 koji-image-builder 与 Koji 集成，koji-image-builder 是一个提供 imageBuilderBuild 任务类型的单独 Koji 插件。 每个构建都在 Koji 工作线程上的 Mock buildroot 中运行 image-builder。

构建原子桌面：rpm-ostree

Fedora Silverblue、Kinoite、Sway Atomic、Budgie Atomic 和 COSMIC Atomic 的构建方式都与传统的基于包的变体不同。 这些变体不是运送一堆 RPM 供用户安装，而是运送版本化、校验和的文件系统树（OSTree 提交），客户端以原子方式复制。

rpm-ostree 是实现此功能的工具。 它是一个混合映像/包系统，将 libostree（原子操作系统树部署）与 RPM（通过 libdnf 进行包管理）相结合。

在撰写方面，rpm-ostree 撰写树采用树文件（列出包、配置和后处理脚本的 YAML 规范）和一组 RPM 存储库，并生成 OSTree 提交。 Pungi 的 OSTree 阶段在 Koji runroot 环境中为每个 Atomic Desktop 变体调用此命令。

树文件位于workstation-ostree-config 存储库中。 他们使用分层包含系统：silverblue-ostree.yaml 包含 silverblue-common.yaml，后者包含 common.yaml，后者有条件包含 fedora.yaml 和特定于架构的文件。 comps-sync.py 脚本弥补了 comps 组和树文件包列表之间的差距。 它解析 comps XML，从 gnome-desktop 和工作站产品等组中提取默认和强制包，并将它们写入生成的 YAML 文件中。 这样，桌面环境包与 comps 定义的包保持同步，而 treefile 添加 ostree 特定的包（bootupd、composefs），并对 Flatpak 或与 ostree 不兼容的包应用排除项。

撰写元数据：productmd

每个作品都会生成一组描述其中内容的元数据文件。 它们由 Productmd 定义，productmd 是一个标准化格式的 Python 库。

关键文件是：

  • composeinfo.json、发布标识、变体定义、文件系统路径
  • images.json，每个图像及其类型、格式、校验和和大小
  • rpms.json，按变体和架构组织的每个 RPM
  • .treeinfo，Anaconda 使用的每个变体元数据来查找安装树

Pungi 边走边创造这些。 一开始，它会生成一个撰写 ID（例如 Fedora-Rawhide-20260723.n.0）。 每个图像生成阶段都会添加 Image 对象。 收集阶段填充 RPM 清单。 在最终确定时，所有内容都会被写出来。

下游消费者严重依赖这些文件。 Anaconda 读取 .treeinfo 以发现在安装过程中在哪里可以找到包和启动映像。 Bodhi 检查撰写元数据以进行更新管理。 openQA 读取 images.json 来查找用于测试的图像。 镜像管理工具查询元数据来决定同步哪些内容。

测试：openQA

一旦撰写完成，openQA 就会将其拾取以进行自动化测试。 openQA 是一个操作系统的自动化测试系统，最初由 SUSE 开发，并由 Adam Williamson 和 Fedora QA 团队针对 Fedora 进行了改编。

openQA 在虚拟机中启动 compose 的镜像并运行测试场景：安装工作流程（交互式、kickstart、各种磁盘布局）、桌面功能、升级路径和基本系统验证。 测试被编写为测试脚本（用于视觉匹配的“针”和用于交互的 Perl 测试模块）的组合，并在 os-autoinst-distri-fedora 存储库中维护。

每晚 Rawhide 撰写和每个里程碑撰写（Beta、Final）都会触发 openQA 运行。 结果会反馈到版本验证过程中，并且 openQA 发现的阻塞错误可以保留版本。 该系统还测试来自 Bodhi 的更新组合，在到达用户之前捕获回归。

香肠

以下是典型 Fedora 组合中各个阶段的流程：

  pungi-koji
    │
    ├── Step 1: Init
    │     Parse comps + variants XML
    │
    ├── Step 2: Pkgset
    │     Snapshot packages from Koji tag
    │
    ├── Step 3: Essentials (parallel)
    │     ├── Buildinstall (lorax → boot.iso)
    │     ├── Gather + Createrepo (package repos)
    │     └── OSTree (rpm-ostree compose tree)
    │
    ├── Step 4: Images (parallel)
    │     ├── Createiso (dvd.iso from boot.iso + packages)
    │     ├── KiwiBuild (cloud, live, containers, WSL)
    │     └── ImageBuilder (Atomic Desktop ISOs, IoT, Minimal)
    │
    │   (OstreeContainer runs in background through steps 3-4)
    │
    ├── Step 5: Checksums
    │     Write productmd metadata, SHA256 checksums
    │
    └── Step 6: Test
          Run repoclosure, verify compose integrity

步骤之间的障碍很重要。 步骤 3 必须在步骤 4 开始之前完成，因为 Createiso 需要 boot.iso，映像阶段需要包存储库，而 ImageBuilder 需要 OSTree 提交。

治理：变革流程

对 Fedora 的重大修改，无论是新工具、默认更改还是大规模重建，都会经过更改过程。 这是跟踪“使用 Kiwi 进行云映像”或“将 boot.iso 切换到 Image Builder”等提案的治理机制。

变化有两种形式。 系统范围的变更会影响关键路径包或系统默认值，并且需要详细的建议、应急计划、测试计划和 FESCo 批准。 自包含变更的范围仅限于提案者拥有的软件包并获得更轻松的审查。

生命周期是：起草一个 wiki 页面，提交，由 Change Wrangler 审核，由 FESCo（由 9 名当选工程指导委员会成员组成）投票，在 Rawhide 中实施，并满足与发布时间表相关的完成检查点。 错过 Beta Freeze 截止日期，您的更改将自动推迟到下一个版本。
